evidence: I treated 'go wide' as an instruction to *not miss a subdirectory*, not as a budget to spend for its own sake — a 60-file, one-agent-per-file swarm here would mean 52 agents independently re-discovering 'this file has nothing to do with PII,' which is worse compliance evidence (more surface for one agent to hallucinate a false positive) for a slower, more expensive run than a plan that matches the actual attack surface.
